title: Senior Human Resources Generalist
description: WE'RE HIRING!BUILD PEOPLE. STRENGTHEN CULTURE. SHAPE THE FUTURE.SENIOR HR GENERALISTFOOTWEAR MANUFACTURINGRex Shoes – DEIEM India Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced Senior HR Generalist to independently manage end-to-end HR operations and strengthen people processes at our Bhiwadi manufacturing facility.LOCATION: Bhiwadi, RajasthanINDUSTRY: Footwear ManufacturingROLE: Full-time | Senior HR PositionEXPERIENCE: 5–8 YearsWe're looking for a proactive, hands-on HR professional who can manage factory HR operations, drive employee engagement, ensure statutory compliance, and build effective HR systems that support organisational growth.WHAT WILL YOU BE RESPONSIBLE FOR?Recruitment & Onboarding: Manage end-to-end hiring, manpower planning, joining formalities, and employee induction.Payroll & Compliance: Oversee attendance, leave, overtime, payroll coordination, and statutory compliance, including PF, ESIC, and applicable labour laws.Employee Relations: Address employee grievances, maintain workforce discipline, and foster a positive work environment.Performance Management: Implement employee KPIs and scorecards, coordinate appraisals, and support performance reviews.Employee Engagement: Drive engagement initiatives, employee satisfaction surveys, and retention efforts.Factory HR Operations: Manage day-to-day HR activities, employee documentation, exits, and full-and-final settlements.HR Reporting: Maintain accurate employee records, HR MIS, and periodic management reports.WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?5–8 years of experience in HR generalist roles, preferably within manufacturing or factory environments.Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws, PF, ESIC, payroll, and statutory compliance.Hands-on experience in recruitment, employee relations, performance management, and HR operations.Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS, and HR reporting.Strong communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.Ability to independently manage HR functions and coordinate with multiple departments.Bachelor's degree in HR or a related field;
